title: Release 2026.10.06: every caller lands in GeneralSupport
scenario: A green pipeline run shipped Larkspur's natural-language front door to prod. Within 30 minutes GeneralSupport waits passed 15 minutes, password-reset self-service stopped working and callers were never asked what they need. On-call blames Lambda cold starts. You get the pipeline log, flow logs, Lambda logs, metrics, the flow diff and the pipeline code.
task: Trace the failing block and what it references, with flow log and artifact evidence
Explain why promote, lint and the synthetic call were all green; rule the Lambda theory in or out
Fix the promote step, regenerate release/prod, implement the check-refs gate
Write root cause, evidence and prevention in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Every ARN in release/prod belongs to the prod inventory
Promote reproduces the expected prod content
check-refs flags the shipped artifact with path and reason and passes the fixed ones
Root cause backed by evidence in ANSWER.md
